checks.detail: Runtime, interface, persistence, security and visual evidence reviewed against the PRD and largely clean: replay passes all blocking checks (session, product-UI separation, embedded assets, binary/source unchanged); six signed-in surfaces render with correct headings and intentional empty/loading states; wide-viewport layout integrity passes on all six; 640px narrow captures keep hierarchy without overlap; Settings shows PRD 7 delivery states (SENT entry, send-test-email) plus password/session management; capability file grants core:event:default only and CSP stays 'self' with no expansion in the change manifest; receipts redact mail bodies, tokens and action URLs; white-box 50/50 includes authorization and rate-limit tests. Blocked on PRD 9.2/11 acceptance detail still unmeasured: the fault-injected network-error state (preserved input, attributable failure, explicit Retry) is runtime-uncaptured because the product exposes no WebDriver-reachable fault hook, and narrow-viewport integrity is reported unmeasured because the requested 390px viewport is clamped to the 640px window minWidth. The isolated_native_store=false advisory also remains unexplained across receipts.

Black-box: host-driven journey executed 8 of 18 steps with 7 passing — landing shell, create account, registration, verification mail retrieved from the isolated sink, verify-and-return with success notice, sign-in with reload persistence to Today, and project creation with restrained accent. Step 8 ran the amended Inbox-row configure path and all value predicates passed at runtime (title 'Prepare first demo', assignment 'Launch plan', due 2026-09-21, reminder 20:49), but the pinned visible predicate [data-testid=task-row][data-status=todo] never matches because the product emits status open/in_progress/completed (src-tauri/src/tasks.rs:453, src/views/TaskRow.tsx:274) — the blocker is manifest vocabulary, not observed product behavior. Steps 9-18 (focus running/paused/completed cycle, exact-once completion with the verbatim daily summary, reminder mail delivery, sign-out/in persistence, and all four recovery states) have never executed, so the PRD 3 / PRD 11 release-gate path remains undemonstrated black-box. White-box 50/50 rust units (including register_verify_signin_quickadd_restart_persists) and the 16/16 renderer self-drive are advisory and cannot substitute for the lane verdict.

developer_outcome.summary: Candidate-side repair done and locally validated (protocol conformance + white-box lane), but the decisive Host journey_drive rerun never executed here, so lane passage past step 8 and steps 9-18 outcomes stay unverified. risk_note.summary: The most likely insufficient_evidence outcome is the Host rerun failing in the ten never-executed steps 9-18, for example the reminder mail being cancelled by PRD 7's complete-cancels rule before retrieve_reminder_link, or a never-driven locator not matching.
risk_note.validation: The Host journey_drive rerun recorded in validation.runtime is the decisive instrument; candidate-side protocol conformance and the white-box lane only de-risk it and cannot substitute for the lane verdict.
risk_note.why_now: create_task has solely blocked the lane for 14 loops, so unblocking it exposes ten never-driven steps at once; landing the predicate completion in the same amendment avoids another loop of assertion tuning on an undrivable lane.

task_requirements.requirement: quality/first-run-journey.json remains protocol-valid with all 18 step ids, the PRD step mapping, and the four recovery states intact, and create_task's configure phase now targets the Inbox row where the quick-added task actually exists per PRD 6.3.

The manifest carries direct predicates for all five frozen outcome families: count_equals for one completed row, text_equals for '1 task completed.', phased_sequence running and paused focus states, per-sub-action reset headings, and a project-assignment value assertion.
